**Step Title: Remove one feature from Model A: effect on (Model Bias)**2**

**Hint 1:** Consider how removing a feature from a model affects its ability to capture the underlying data patterns. Think about whether the model becomes more or less flexible and how that might impact the bias.

**Hint 2:** Recall the bias-variance tradeoff. When you remove a feature, the model might not fit the training data as well. How does this change in fit relate to the concept of bias in the model?
